headline: The system does its own plumbing now — no more migration prompts you don't understand.

items.prompt_template: Behavior change worth knowing: when an update introduces a small repair or backfill for your workspace, I now do it on your behalf and tell you what I did — instead of asking you to type a phrase to make it happen. Three things that used to prompt you (memory hygiene, linking older to-discuss items, registering missing default chats) now just happen silently when applicable, with a one-line notice after. The only things I'll still ask about are genuine choices — your assistant's name, what kind of operator you are — that only you can answer.

Same change applied to your org classifications: when I first learn the vendor / prospect / dormant taxonomy on your workspace, I auto-tier from your email patterns instead of asking you to confirm each one. If you ever want to review the inferred tiers, say `recheck my org classifications`.
